missing_scripts.rationale: v7.A acceptance requires verifying dispatcher action -> engine routing actually executes a real engine. Without this, F-r2-a1-02 stays exploitable. Reuse scripts/system-viz-query.mjs as substrate — add 'verify-bridge <action>' subcommand that resolves dispatcher route, imports the engine, executes a canonical call, and asserts response shape !== {ok:false,stub:true}.
Spans-config drives multi-axis controller fan-out; without a matrix verifier, frontend can claim coverage on missing combos. Lower priority than verify-bridge but required for v7.A pass.

stop_on_unwired_assets hook exists but checks at Stop, not at acceptance time. CI/v7.A needs a synchronous gate. Implementable in <100L by traversing dispatcher source files and asserting no engine import resolves to a stub (line-count < 30 + zero method bodies).

Sieve test files that have fewer than N real assertions (toBe / toEqual / toBeCloseTo / toThrow / toMatchObject) and emit a denylist for v7.A. toBeDefined()/toBeTruthy()/toBeNull() count as 0.5 each. Threshold: ≥3 real assertions or file flagged as fake-test. Pair with H:/.claude/rules/tests.md 'minimum 10 cases' rule.

missing_scripts.referenced_in: (proposed addition — direct fix for F-r2-a1-02 stub:true leak)
missing_scripts.rationale: Static-scan all engines in mcp-server/src/engines for files <30L OR functions whose entire body is `return {ok:false,stub:true}` or `// TODO` or `throw new Error('not implemented')`. Emit JSON list keyed by engine; cross-reference with dispatcher routing tables to identify which actions are stub-trapped. Single source of truth for the catalog this agent produced.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Banned-return-shape assertion in MS0 acceptance
v7a_hardening_proposal.current: MS0 acceptance test: '.physics-card not empty' (per round 2 finding F-r2-a1-02).
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: Acceptance test must inspect dispatcher response JSON and FAIL on `result.ok === false`, `result.stub === true`, `result.notImplemented === true`, or `result.placeholder === true`. Implementation: shared helper `expectNotStub(result)` in mcp-server/src/__tests__/_helpers/expectNotStub.ts; required by every dispatcher-action E2E test.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Engine-LOC floor in stub-detector
v7a_hardening_proposal.current: No automated detection that an engine file is degenerate.
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: scripts/check-engine-wired.mjs FAILS on any engine routed from a dispatcher whose .ts file is <30 lines OR whose default method body is single-return placeholder. Wire as v7.A gate AND as pre-push hook.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Real-assertion floor on engine tests
v7a_hardening_proposal.current: Test files with 1 `toBeDefined()` pass; AUDIT-LATEST #541 shows MillingForceEngine.test.ts (565L) testing methods that do not exist on stub — risk of silent skip.
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: scripts/audit-test-assertion-density.mjs: each *.test.ts referenced by an engine MUST have >=3 real assertions (toBe/toEqual/toBeCloseTo/toThrow/toMatchObject) AND >=10 it() blocks per H:/.claude/rules/tests.md. toBeDefined/toBeTruthy/toBeNull/toBeFalsy count as 0.5 each. Files below threshold fail v7.A.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Round-trip dispatcher-action invocation in v7.A
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: verify-bridge subcommand executes EACH advertised dispatcher action with a canonical input, captures response, asserts not stub-shaped and dimensions/units are physical (e.g. cutting force in N, MRR in cm^3/min). Wire to PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md action enumeration so new actions get auto-included.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Test-file-to-engine collision detector
v7a_hardening_proposal.current: MillingForceEngine.test.ts imports a class that does not exist on the stub (#541) — passes CI either via silent skip or alias.
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: Pre-test gate: for every *.test.ts, statically resolve every `import` against the source file; FAIL if any named import does not exist in the target module. Catches the #541 false-green class.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Chatter routing collision
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: v7.A includes a uniqueness check: every dispatcher case must route to an engine present in ENGINE_DIGEST.md AND not have a competing canonical engine flagged by duplicationGuardEngine. If a competing canonical exists, fail and require explicit `// CANONICAL-FACADE: <reason>` tag.

v7a_hardening_proposal.title: Frontend acceptance must echo dispatcher result, not card-render
v7a_hardening_proposal.current: MS0 UI acceptance is 'card renders with live data' — passes when card renders `Error: stub` text.
v7a_hardening_proposal.proposed: MS0 acceptance includes a JSON contract assertion: the *response object* delivered to the UI must pass expectNotStub. Card render is necessary-not-sufficient.

summary.verdict: BLOCKER — v7.A acceptance gate is hollow as currently specified. Six dispatcher actions (mill physics + 3 scientific + chatter + blueprint join CAD side) return {ok:false,stub:true} while satisfying MS0 'card renders with live data'. At least one test file (MillingForceEngine.test.ts, 565L) is structurally impossible against its target stub — it either silently skips or alias-resolves a different module, both indistinguishable from false-green. 16 confirmed weak-assertion test files via `it(...toBeDefined())` pattern; full corpus likely much larger. None of the three v7.A-referenced scripts (verify-bridge, spans-config-matrix, check-engine-wired) exist on disk. v7.A must be hardened with 7 explicit gates (H1-H7) before MS0 can be accepted.
summary.one_line: Six stub-trapped dispatcher actions + sixteen false-green tests + zero of three v7.A scripts on disk; harden v7.A with expectNotStub helper, engine-LOC floor, assertion-density floor, round-trip action invocation, import-resolution gate, routing-uniqueness check, and JSON-contract MS0 acceptance.
